authorization: 3 October user explicitly authorized testing monthly statistical summaries, improved spatial sampling, and their combination; all earlier models and occurrence cohorts remain preserved.

definitions.temperature_median_minus_mean_c: Median of12 monthly mean-temperature normals minus equal-month mean, degC.
definitions.temperature_iqr_c: 75th minus25th percentile of12 monthly temperature normals; NumPy linear quantiles, degC.
definitions.temperature_skew: Population third standardized central moment across12 monthly temperature normals, dimensionless.
definitions.precipitation_median_over_mean: Median of12 monthly precipitation totals divided by their mean, dimensionless.
definitions.precipitation_iqr_over_mean: Linear75th minus25th monthly precipitation percentiles divided by monthly mean, dimensionless.
definitions.precipitation_skew: Population third standardized central moment across12 monthly precipitation totals, dimensionless.
definitions.precipitation_normalized_entropy: -sum(q*log(q))/log12 for monthly annual fractions q;0log0=0. One is even year-round precipitation, zero a single wet month.
definitions.wettest_circular_3month_fraction: Largest fraction of annual precipitation in any consecutive three months, with December/January wrap.
definitions.driest_circular_3month_fraction: Smallest fraction of annual precipitation in any consecutive three months, with December/January wrap.
definitions.precipitation_harmonic_cos: sum(q*cos(theta)), same calendar convention. Do not divide by amplitude or assign a peak date when amplitude is zero.
definitions.precipitation_temperature_offset_c: sum(q*(T-meanT)), degC; weights warmth of precipitation-bearing months. Not measured breeding temperature.

compact_baseline: Existing annual meanT, log1p annualP, monthly meanT range and population precipitationCV plus fourteen fixed summaries.
numerics: float64 definitions, float32 model columns, finite12months/nonnegativeP/positiveannualP required; exact constant-series skew0; no variance threshold, clipping or omitted cells.
source: Existing aligned CHELSA2.1 1981–2010 monthly mean-temperature and precipitation-normal arrays;19 BIOCLIM physical arrays from same source/grid. Precipitation includes snow.
predictor_semantics: Medians/skews describe the12 climate-normal months, not daily weather, interannual variation, extremes, hydroperiod or phenology. All new features are deterministic functions of the monthly input. Quarter shares overlap BIOCLIM information; no novelty claim for every formula.
borders: One training-only 61-column cutoff bank per outer split, built from original permitted presence rows plus unchanged background before thinning; shared across all sampling arms and remapped by feature name/index for crossed families. Dropped presence covariates already remain in background; no held data.
objective: Existing native weighted BCE, equal occupied-cell and area/inclusion background mass; relative recorded-density evaluation, no calibrated occupancy.
sampling: Training-only equal-cell / 5km / 10km arms; original held cells, target areas, q cells, area weights and inclusion probabilities unchanged. Thinned-out occupied cells remain area-integration locations, never newly asserted absences. BCE positive/background mass and damping recomputed from retained n.
folds: Intermontana/bombifrons/multiplicata retain5 folds and50km guards; North/South retain3 folds and30km guards. Different available landscapes prevent ranking species by absolute scores.
selection: No inner tuning, best-performing feature/radius choice, hyperparameter selection or full-data fits. Freeze all thinning masks and support checks before fitting. Maximum retained count among declared thinning attempts is a training-coordinate heuristic, not held-score selection or a proven optimum.
primary_score: Equal occupied50km-block held mean per fold, then equal folds within species; retain paired changes and every fold.
secondary_score: Equal recorded-cell mean per fold; prediction concentration/entropy and marginal support diagnostics retained.
inference: Previously inspected development geography, fixed shallow learner and combined summary set. Feature gains test representation; sampling arms test procedural declustering. Neither identifies effort, causal climate effects, physiological niches, guaranteed independent sites, occupancy or hindcast validity. Without a size-matched deletion control, effects of spatial selection and smaller n are not separated.
stop: Complete all supported slots of the 315 declared maximum fits, preserve unsupported slots and every paired fold, summarize feature/sampling/interaction contrasts and stop. No radius/seed/tuning/history sweep or automatic replacement of existing models.

thinning.algorithm: Iterative maximum-neighbor-degree removal with seeded random ties; WGS84 geodesic distances between inherited native-cell centers.
thinning.seed_schedule: base + species_index*1000 + fold*20 + attempt; identical seed list for each radius.
thinning.selection: Largest retained subset among the ten declared attempts; ties select earliest attempt. Training coordinates and counts only, no held scores or precision priority.
thinning.unsupported: Preserve unsupported slots and their counts; do not fit, silently reduce folds, relax thresholds or redraw data.
thinning.precision: Cell-center separation is not source-location accuracy or proof of independent sites. Original source identity/uncertainty and 30/50 km validation guards are retained.
